In the previous blog post in this series, I fit a case of 'buy-till-you-die' (BTYD) models to a transaction log from an ecommerce retailer. The model provided insight into customer churn dynamics, even though the setting was non-contractual (customers were free to make purchases at any time). In this post, I build upon that model by introducing the spending component, formalizing the application to customer lifetime value (CLV).

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(CLVTools)
```
